note: The Intent probe's labeled corpus (help-intent-probe.cli.ts). `intent` is the Intent a correct reading gives; `alt` lists other Intents that are also correct, only for a question whose plans both answer it (a world's own script reads as Code or World). `secondAsk` is true when the message asks for a second thing of another Intent, and `intent` is then the first ask's. `where` is the open screen as the answer request words it. A follow-up carries the last exchange in `earlier` and `earlierAnswer`; its message alone does not name its Intent. `set`: `dev` cases may steer a prompt revision; `blind` cases were written with the dev set, before any run, and no revision is tuned on them. The `hp-` and `bhp-` cases (a how-to phrased as a problem in story words) were added in one pass after help-recall showed that phrasing misrouted, before the revision that targets it ran. Kinds: help, code, world, lore (game-side story questions), chat, create, offEditor (a create ask from a screen with no World Editor), twoAsk, oneAsk (an 'and' that is still one ask), followUp, language.
